entities.name: Rais Abin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rais Abin was an Indonesian military officer and diplomat who served as the Commander of the Second United Nations Emergency Force in Egypt from 1976 until 1979, Indonesian Ambassador to Malaysia from 1981 until 1984, and Indonesian Ambassador to Singapore from 1984 until 1986.
